title: Iron Butcher - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Iron Butcher in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Iron Butcher phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Iron Butcher is a story encounter in Mountain of Imprisonment.

sections.title: Where to Find the Iron Butcher
sections.content: Location: Mountain of Imprisonment - the region itself rather than a point inside it.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: No drop is recorded for this encounter in the sources checked, so none is listed. That is a gap in the record rather than a statement that it drops nothing.

sections.title: How to Beat the Iron Butcher
sections.content:
What works

  • Dodge the heavy strikes, then punish recovery - the same rule as most of the Imprisonment roster.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 46 of 60 in the progression order, in Mountain of Imprisonment. Before it: Acolyte Guhe. After it: Bi Feng, Giant Saber Commander (巨刀统领 白峰). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
